I admire Eric Rudolph, though I don't necessarily espouse his causes.
I am gay and also think that abortion should be legal.  But I always
admire a good rebel, someone who fights for what they believe in,
even if it means people got killed.  My 2 biggest heroes are Charles
Manson and Ted Kaczynski (the Unabomber).  I especially like Ted
because he wrote a Manifesto.  The Unabomber Manifesto is very good
reading - he outlines a plan to destroy technological/industrial
society and uses very good arguments to persuade the reader.
Charlie is just plain cool as hell.  When I listen to him it is like
listening to the voice of Jesus.  Something about him - it's like
he has the power to hyptotize you just by staring at you.  Even
though what he says in mostly gibberish, he has a way of saying it
(perhaps his tone of voice) that brainwashes you into believing it.

"It's just a pile of shit, so why not try to grow some flowers in it?"
-- Charles Manson

"In order to get our message before the public with some chance
of making a lasting impression, we've had to kill people."
-- The Unabomber
